The '''Sacred Staff''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact owned by the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Jahai]].

==History==
Around [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Sacred Staff was located in Otoh Jahai under the leadership of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Tenko]]. It was stolen from the city by the minions of [[Rogoe/Legends|Boss Rogoe]] in order to continue the [[War of the Gungan tribes]].
